A full flash can replace the factory system or other firmware on devices without flash encryption or secure boot. Books, progress, and Pico Page settings on your TF card are preserved.

en.不想拔卡？在设备上开启 USB 文件传输，同样可以放入书和字体。也可以用 Wi‑: You can keep the card inserted by using USB file transfer or uploading books from a browser over the device hotspot or a saved Wi‑Fi network. Starting with 0.2.0-beta.3, the same upload page also accepts fonts and lock screen images.
en.TF 卡上没有字体时，正文使用内置字体。内置字体只包含 3,500 个常用汉字，: If there is no font on the TF card, body text uses the built-in font. It covers 3,500 commonly used Chinese characters. Characters outside that set appear as boxes. Add a full Chinese font to display additional characters.

en.文件夹名称可以自定，文件夹内的文件保留原名。: You can rename the folders. Keep the filenames inside them.
en.书和进度，都由你保管。: Keep your books and progress in your hands
en.书籍、阅读进度与设置保存在 TF 卡上。开启 USB 文件传输或使用读卡器，就能: Books, reading progress, and settings live on the TF card. Use USB file transfer or a card reader to view, back up, and organize them on your computer.
en.EPUB 和 TXT 无需预先转换。目录、书签和书内链接帮你找到内容，长按插图可: Open EPUB and TXT without converting them. Navigate with the table of contents, bookmarks, and links. Long-press an illustration to view it on its own.
en.同一份 EPUB、同一个同步账户，与 KOReader 接续阅读位置。检查、采用: Sync your position in the same EPUB with KOReader using the same sync account. You decide when to check, move, or upload.
en.字体、字号、行距和页边距，预览后再应用。每本书可保留不同设置。三档刷新模式按需选: Preview changes to font, font size, line spacing, and margins. Keep different settings for each book and choose among three refresh modes.
en.USB 文件传输，或经设备热点、已保存的 Wi‑Fi 用浏览器上传。Wi‑Fi: Use USB file transfer or upload in a browser through the device hotspot or a saved Wi‑Fi network. Wi‑Fi accepts books up to 64 MiB and skips existing filenames.
en.支持 EPUB，以及 UTF-8、GB18030 编码的 TXT。暂不支持 PD: Supports EPUB and TXT encoded in UTF-8 or GB18030. PDF, annotations, and highlights are unavailable.

en.KOReader 位置接续仅支持 EPUB；超出精确定位范围时，不提供跳转。TX: Position sync with KOReader is available for EPUB only. You can jump to the remote position when it can be located precisely. TXT progress stays local.
en.EPUB 默认使用原书排版，也可在「排版」中切换到「统一排版」。表格与复杂版式可: EPUB uses the book’s original layout by default. To use a uniform layout, choose Uniform layout in Layout. Tables and complex layouts may be simplified. Unsupported content may fail to open.

en.复制到 TF 卡根目录，已有同名文件夹时合并。单张下载的 PNG 也放进这个文件: to the root of the TF card. Merge it with the existing folder if there is one. Put individual PNG downloads in the same folder.
en.「设置 → 电源与休眠」选「自定义图片」，在「选择图片 / 轮播」中固定一张或选: In Settings → Power & sleep, select Custom image. In Choose image / rotation, choose a fixed image or rotate through the images.
en.点击「保存设置」。0.2.0-beta.3 起，休眠会等待图片准备（0.2.0-: Tap Save settings. Starting with 0.2.0-beta.3, sleep waits while the image is prepared. Starting with 0.2.0-beta.4, a second short press on the power button cancels the wait. Touch and K1, K2, and K3 are ignored. On older firmware, leave the device idle for a moment before putting it to sleep.

en.透明叠加需要 0.4.0 及更高版本固件。在「设置 → 电源与休眠」选择「自定义: Transparent overlays require firmware 0.4.0 or later. In Settings → Power & sleep, select Custom image, enable Overlay on current screen, and save.
en.印章采用放大后的右下内收位置。植物的叶片、花瓣与枝干主体为不透明白色，背景及枝叶: The enlarged seals sit inward from the bottom-right corner. Leaves, petals, and stems are opaque white. Their backgrounds and the gaps between them are transparent, so the underlying text cannot show through the solid parts.
en.上方缩略图仅展示主体，下载文件保留完整透明画布。三方古印为公有领域原作的印面忠实: The previews show the artwork alone. Downloads retain the full transparent canvas. The three historic seals faithfully reproduce public-domain impressions. Pico Page designed the modern seals and made the botanical drawings with help from ImageGen.
